protocol_amendment.change: frequency Hessian algorithm: NumFreq (numerical finite difference of analytical gradients) -> AnFreq (analytical Hessian)
protocol_amendment.authority: plan v1.2 item 4: an amendment must be global and cohort-wide, never a per-leg selection; this change applies to the whole cohort
evidence: 60/60 legs paired on identical converged geometries: 54 agree, 6 disagree; every disagreement is a leg whose NumFreq imaginary mode vanishes or shrinks under AnFreq

DX step-size sensitivity probe (AN/LiM_2plus): NumFreq DX=0.005 -> -127.20 cm-1, DX=0.010 -> -57.21 cm-1, AnFreq -> 0; a real saddle does not halve its imaginary frequency when the difference step changes, so the NumFreq modes are finite-difference noise
AnFreq Hessian contains CPCM-Hessian and SMD-Hessian terms and the ORCA warnings block is empty (no missing model term)
Opt VeryTightOpt AnFreq keyword combination smoke-tested (optimisation converges, frequency block complete)
ORCA 6.0/6.1 manual: analytical Hessians are available for SCF/DFT; restrictions are double-hybrids and RI-JK, neither of which applies here
unchanged_by_this_amendment: geometry optimisation tier (VeryTightOpt) and its frozen thresholds
functional wB97X-D4, state-specific target basis, SMD(acetonitrile), qRRHO thermochemistry policy
the prohibition on numerical FIRST derivatives (NumGrad remains forbidden)
protocol_amendment.recomputation_scope: cohort-wide: every leg's frequency Hessian must come from AnFreq on its own converged geometry, so all labels stay mutually comparable

geometry_and_frequency: wB97X-D4 / state-specific target basis / SMD(acetonitrile), Opt VeryTightOpt AnFreq TightSCF SlowConv for all newly generated or rescued legs

derivative_policy.terminology: NumFreq is not NumGrad; AnFreq changes the Hessian algorithm, not the frozen first-derivative requirement
derivative_policy.superseded_frequency_hessian: numerical finite difference of analytical gradients
derivative_policy.supersession_reason: finite-difference Hessian produced spurious imaginary modes under SMD for the flexible/charged legs; the paired audit plus the DX step-size probe showed the modes are discretisation noise, not curvature
derivative_policy.anfreq_audit: completed cohort-wide (60/60 legs) on identical converged geometries; see outputs/physics_completion/method_audit/anfreq_paired_audit.md
derivative_policy.anfreq_adoption_gate: SATISFIED: exact wB97X-D4/basis/SMD compatibility, complete model terms (CPCM/SMD Hessian present, empty warnings block), full-mode and thermochemistry QC; adopted globally rather than per leg
derivative_policy.legacy_numfreq_results_policy: existing NumFreq legs are superseded for label purposes; they are retained as Hessian-method sensitivity evidence, not deleted, and must not be mixed with AnFreq labels in one comparison

geometry_convergence_policy.imaginary_mode_workflow: restart from latest converged geometry with VeryTightOpt, then NumFreq and paired AnFreq on the identical final geometry before mode displacement or sampling-limited classification
geometry_convergence_policy.legacy_policy: retain prior TightOpt legs only when zero-imaginary-mode and all other QC passed; imaginary, suspicious-low-mode and resubmitted legs require VeryTightOpt
geometry_convergence_policy.evidence_required: convergence tier plus final energy, maximum/RMS gradient and maximum/RMS displacement criteria

label_eligibility_rule: A production redox or coordination label is eligible only when both legs use wB97X-D4/def2-TZVPD/SMD(acetonitrile) with the frozen thermochemistry policy. Existing M/def2-TZVP jobs are pilot diagnostics and must not be subtracted from def2-TZVPD charged legs.
selection_basis: ORCA 6.1.1 keyword support and neutral/charged smoke-run success
range-separated hybrid as the preregistered production family
diffuse functions retained for every state so paired legs use one basis rule
numerical stability, QC usability, and a single internally consistent label definition
selection_prohibition: The production method was not selected to maximize inversion count, preserve a preferred pair sign, or improve agreement with the target list.
audit_control: PBE0-D4/def2-TZVPD remains an independent sensitivity control and is not a second production method.
supersedes_candidate_ambiguity: method_settings.csv S1 and S2 were both labelled production_candidate; this freeze selects S2 for target labels and retains S1 only as historical pilot/diagnostic evidence.
